title: Pregnant Duo #43
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Korean, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold a ring. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer, a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of jewel-toned scenework wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Spanish, in her early 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, no sharp cinch at the middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, natural soft black hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real pores, real living eyes, 15 bars piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum a necklace. Painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting, a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of folk-art florals wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme gold extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
